summary: Speechmatics advertises $100 in free speech-to-text credits for new accounts, no card required, with 55+ languages and 2 concurrent real-time sessions on Free. Separately, its text-to-speech pricing offers the first 1 million characters free. Current public pricing does not establish that the $100 STT credit is a shared STT/TTS pool. This listing is awaiting curator verification; signup and inference have not been tested in this source check.
claim_steps: Sign up at https://portal.speechmatics.com/signup/ — the $100 STT offer states no card required.
Check the account's $100 speech-to-text credit allowance and Free-tier limit of 2 concurrent real-time sessions.
For text-to-speech, check the separate first-1-million-characters-free allowance; do not assume it draws from the $100 STT credit.
Review current billing terms before continuing beyond either free allowance.

social_proof.title: Speechmatics pricing: Speech to Text from $0.121/hr
social_proof.text: Start free • $100 in credits ... No card required ... Concurrent sessions (Real-time) 50 (2 on Free) ... Text to Speech ... First 1 million characters free (about 20 hours of speech).
